name: Estonia
notes: Depth: seed. Scope: national and European Parliament roll call; register = 5 NUTS 3 regions and 79 omavalitsused (LAU; the 15 maakonnad are not in the register). First pass R001 (2026-11-04). Estonia has a land tax but no net-wealth tax; the 2024-26 'ettevõtete varamaks' (company asset tax) and the 'security tax' are excluded. Map: Eurostat GISCO LAU 2024 (units) and NUTS 2024 level 3 (regions), CC BY 4.0, codes are Eurostat LAU codes (units). Seats tab: Riigikogu (101 seats) from api.riigikogu.ee.
